deals.title: Birthday bonus: 2,000 loyalty points

deals.title: Second purchase: 40% off + free item

deals.title: Senior (55+) discount

deals.title: Third purchase: 50% off + free item + 3,000 points

deals.title: Veterans & first responders 25% off

deals.title: 60% off after medical card renewal

events.name: Cannabis Clinical Outcomes Research Conference (CCORC) 2026
events.venue: UF Academic and Research Center at Lake Nona
events.description: Sixth annual University of Florida-led conference where researchers, physicians and industry leaders share medical marijuana clinical research. It includes keynotes, poster sessions, panels, an exhibitor hall, networking and some virtual attendance options.

news.headline: Curaleaf Continues Florida Expansion, Opens Wellington Dispensary
news.summary: Curaleaf opened a new medical dispensary at 2495 S State Road 7 in Wellington, which brings its Florida store count to 79. A grand opening runs Oct 16–17 with patient promotions, including a free eighth for the first 25 qualifying medical card holders each day, and the store adds access for patients in Wellington and nearby Palm Beach County communities.
